description: This file declares the CPowerState class, which manages power states in a system service context. It includes methods for starting, stopping, setting, and getting the power state, along with a singleton instance method.

classes.name: CPowerState
classes.description: A class providing interface to manage power states, including starting, stopping, setting, and retrieving power state information.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CPowerState.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the power state service or process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the power state service or process.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the system's power state to the specified value.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current system power state as a string.
